rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE JURISDICTION OF LABOR CASES BETWEEN THE NATIONAL LABOR RELATION COMMISSION AND THE REGIONAL OFFICES OF THE DEPARTMENT OF LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE, ARTICLES 129 AND 217 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE FOUR HUNDRED FORTY TWO (PD 442), AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBER 7227, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'BASES CONVERSION AND DEVELOPMENT ACT OF 1992' AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NUMBER 7917, ADJUSTING THE ALLOCATION OF REVENUES FROM THE SALE, LEASE, JOINT-VENTURE AGREEMENTS AND OTHER TRANSACTIONS INVOLVING MILITARY BASES RESERVATIONS, ALLOCATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill provides for a) the inclusion of the proceeds of the sale, lease, joint-venture agreements involving military bases and reservations as part of the capitalization of the Conversion Authority; b) rationalization of the funding scheme of the Conversion Authority; c) equitable redistribution of the proceeds from transactions involving military bases, among others.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASES CONVERSION since 2007-07-30

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A PRE-TRIAL RELEASE FOR THE ACCUSED, CREATING FOR THE PURPOSE THE PRE-TRIAL RELEASE OFFICE (PTRO), APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: “Pre-Trial Release Act of 2007”. The bill provides persons arrested and charged with crimes except those involving heinous crimes, the opportunity to be released immediately without need to post a bail bond by way of the Pre-Need Trial Release Program.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2007-07-30

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE WORKERS' COMPENSATION PROGRAM, THE WORK CONTINGENCY INSURANCE FUND, THE PHILIPPINE WORKERS' COMPENSATION AUTHORITY AND DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS AND AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLES 166 TO 208-A OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE FOUR HUNDRED FORTY TWO (PD 442), AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: \"Workers' Compensation Act of 2007\".  The bill provides a clear description of the Workers Compensation Program and its components, namely, coverage, benefits, rehabilitation of occupationally disabled workers, and work contingency prevention. It seeks the creation of a Work Contingency Insurance Fund from which payment of benefits shall be sourced.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2007-07-30

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AND SANITATION, INTEGRATING THE DIFFERENT GOVERNMENT AGENCIES RELATED TO ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AND SANITATION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Department of Environment Protection and Sanitation Act\"
rows.abstract: \"Department of Environment Protection and Sanitation Act\".   The bill creates the Department that will serve as the primary government agency to formulate, coordinate, regulate and integrate existing plans, policies and programs relative to environmental protection and sanitation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2007-07-30

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A MORE RESPONSIVE AND COMPREHENSIVE REGULATION FOR THE PRACTICE, LICENSING, AND REGISTRATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL AND SANITARY ENGINEERS IN THE PHILIPPINES AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 1364, AND OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Revised Environmental and Sanitary Engineering Act of 2007\"
rows.abstract: \"Revised Environmental and Sanitary Engineering Act of 2007\".  The measure seeks to update the scope of Environment and Sanitary Engineering in order to make the profession globally competitive.  It creates the Board of Examiners for Environmental and Sanitary Engineers that shall issue certificates of registration. It also provides for the powers and duties of the Board and the qualification of its members. It further provides for the requirements and qualifications of applicants who wish to obtain a license.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2007-07-30

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING THE COOPERATIVE CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES TO BE KNOWN AS THE \"PHILIPPINE COOPERATIVE CODE OF 2007\"
rows.abstract: Philippine Cooperative Code of 2004\".  The measure seeks to amend the Cooperative Code to make the organization of cooperatives more attractive and to provide a fertile social and economic environment for cooperatives to succeed in their endeavors.

rows.author: D045
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING LOI 745 ON THE CREATION OF THE PHILIPPINE COMMISSION ON THE PROMOTION AND DEVELOPMENT OF SCUBA SPORTS & TECHNICAL DIVING AND PRESCRIBING THE PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: \"An Act Amending LOI 745 and Prescribing the Penalties Therefor\"
rows.abstract: \"An Act Amending LOI 745 and Prescribing the Penalties Therefor\".  The bill provides standard basic dive rules to all levels/kinds of divers, regulate the sport and expand the powers of existing governmental agencies in order to further promote the sport and protect the safety of its enthusiasts through the formulation of policies and the imposition of sanctions and penalties for violations thereof.

rows.abstract: \"Batas Laban sa Salvaging\".  Ang panukalang ito ay nagpapataw ng parusang kamatayan sa sinumang opisyal ng pamahalaan, autoridad o alagad ng batas para sa anumang salvaging o pagpatay na hindi utos ng hukuman. (\"The Anti-Salvaging Law\".  The bill provides for the imposition of the death penalty upon any public officer, person in authority or agent of a person in authority for any salvaging or extrajudicial killing.)

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING REGULATORY AND FRANCHISING POWERS TO THE CITY GOVERNMENTS OVER OPERATIONS OF PUBLIC UTILITY JEEPNEYS PLYING ROUTES EXCLUSIVELY WITHIN THE CITY'S TERRITORIAL JURISDICTION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: The bill authorizes the sangguniang panglungsod to grant franchises to public utility jeepneys plying routes exclusively within the city's territorial jurisdiction.
